_comfy_bridge.name: Edit - FLUX 3 Image Klein (distilled)
_comfy_bridge.description: Instruction edit with FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs, Oct 2026), distilled: 16 steps, no CFG. Call the plate <ref_image_0> and describe the change plus what stays. Works at ~1 MP (megapixels) and is scaled back to the plate format. Check the FLUX 3 licence before commercial use.
